trickyParts: ygo's OnTokenAuthContext gets the request context; nothing cancels it while the hook runs, so the hook waits on nothing (a map read under the admissions' mutex).
A revoke cancels the socket's own context with a cause whose CloseCode is 4412; ygo writes the close through gorilla's WriteControl, which is serialized with frame writes, waiting at most 1 s.
From ygo 1.54.1-sami.1 a logged commit's parked structs are in LoggedUpdate.Parked, not Update; the replica applies both.
deviations: D1, D2 and N1's tests are gone with the code they tested (admittedConn, the shared waiting list); the architect's round-5 decision replaced both designs.
The two-build browser run needs a previous build of legion-envoy-v20.1.0 or later (held socket, shared cookie key); build-dispatch-build.sh refuses older ones.
